## The name

Not knowing is usually treated as a gap, something to close as quickly as
possible. We see it differently. While we do not yet know, we can still notice
what is actually happening, rather than what we expected to happen.

This matters most with the body. Much of what is taught about it is less
certain than it sounds, and even what is well established says little about
what one person feels in one moment. A sensation, a breath or a meeting with
another person can be met with a ready answer, or with attention. We would
rather start from the question.

A garden does not grow from a plan alone. Things come up in their own time,
and much of the work is watching and waiting. Notknowing Garden is a place to
practise that, in a room and on the page.
